name: 気力と気分の四領域
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: Lighthouse catalog LH13-0002「気力と気分の四領域」, one isolated component candidate.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image 1 ORIGINAL How We Feel source controls geometry, proportions, optical weight, spacing, organic layered edges and fine details. Image 2 our Japanese FigCraft mock is SECONDARY for Japanese wording and overall composition; do not copy its flat perfect circles, missing layers or all-green palette. Image 3 approved Lighthouse bus direction is STYLE ONLY for white surface, neutral borders, soft restrained shadow. Never import bus/map content.
Primary request: redesign the four-quadrant energy/mood selector in official Lighthouse style while recovering the original organic circle silhouettes and layered contour edges. Four equally sized large circular choice regions arranged tightly 2 by 2. No choice selected, no ticks, no CTA, no navigation or phone frame. Header top-left. Keep logical component size 390x395 and readable touch controls.
Exact Japanese text: header「気力と気分を選ぶ」. Top left「活発・つらい」; top right「活発・心地よい」; bottom left「静か・つらい」; bottom right「静か・心地よい」. Preserve each one-line label centered within its circle. No extra words or explanatory legend.
Typography: Meiryo Bold 20/28 heading, Meiryo Regular 14/24 labels, tracking 0, main ink #1D1D1D, not serif, not extra heavy.
Accent evidence and decision: the source uses coral/red for high-energy unpleasant, amber/yellow high-energy pleasant, blue low-energy unpleasant, green low-energy pleasant. These are meaningful coherent quadrant groups, not random icon decoration. Retain this mapping in restrained overlapping double contour rims, with near-white centers and only a faint localized tint. Preserve recognizable offset organic edges from source. Coral rim #D96560, amber rim #D4A742, blue rim #698DC9, forest-green rim #1F6444. Equal emphasis, no tile looks selected. No chart, no legend, no extra icons.
Surface style: pure white #FFFFFF outer canvas and rounded white card, subtle neutral outline and soft downward shadow, quiet white interiors. No broad mint panel or background tint, neon, heavy gloss, colored ambient glow or nested decorative containers. The green family may have a smooth restrained #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E rim, but do not invent a primary button. Keep all four contours cleanly separated enough for legibility and labels unobstructed. Entire component fully visible with modest white margin. This is a raster design candidate, not a working/editable application.
reviewNotes: 原画の赤/黄/青/緑は高低の気力と快不快の意味分類。原画を細部の主参照として色の対応と有機的な多層輪郭を復元し、モックの全緑・正円を採用しなかった。生成結果実見:4領域・日本語・無選択・白い外面・丸い層状輪郭を確認。ただし内側の色面が強く、本文ラベルがRegular指定より太く見える。白い中心と本文の太さに限定修正が必要。所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・実装とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
